introduction: Oregon TANF supports qualifying families, pregnant people and certain young household heads. Apply online, by phone or at a local ODHS office.
description: Oregon TANF supports qualifying families, pregnant people and certain young household heads. Apply online, by phone or at a local ODHS office.

sections.who: The state reviews Oregon residence, low income and limited resources. The applicant must fit the program’s child-caregiver, pregnancy or young-head-of-household category.
sections.get: Approved cash uses the Oregon Trail EBT card. Most participants also receive a JOBS program assignment to support employment.
sections.docs:
• Household and dependent information.
  • Income and resource records.
  • Other evidence listed in the interview request.
sections.apply:
1. Start the benefit application

    Use the TANF Apply Now route.

  2. Complete the interview

    ODHS schedules a telephone or in-person review.

  3. Review the award and JOBS plan

    Ask what activities apply and explain any barrier requiring help.
sections.after: Keep participation records and report changes under your case instructions. SNAP and OHP can be requested alongside TANF but receive their own eligibility review.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TANF categories, interview and JOBS. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can pregnancy qualify without an existing child?
The state lists pregnancy as an applicant category.
Approved recipients receive an Oregon Trail EBT card.
Can I request food benefits too?
Yes. The state says the TANF application can also request SNAP and OHP.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
